expect.title: Apartment
expect.body: Accommodation apartment is not at Perth CBD area. Note: Each apartment type is provided with only one bathroom.

expect.title: Apartment Room Allocation
expect.body: 2 pax: Twin Sharing · 3 pax: Triple Sharing · 4 pax: Quad Room · 5 pax: Quint Room · 6 pax: 2x Triple Room.

expect.title: Transportation & Guide
expect.body: Tour duration as mentioned in itinerary. AUD50/hour will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash to driver.

expect.title: Arrival & Departure
expect.body: Additional surcharge applies to airport transfers between 10:01 PM - 05:59 AM. Please arrive & depart between 06:00 AM - 10:00 PM to avoid additional charges.

expect.title: Peak Seasons Date
expect.body: Peak Seasons Surcharge may apply on these dates: 19 - 31 March 2026, 1 - 20 April 2026, 1 - 15 July 2026, 19 - 31 August 2026, 1 - 30 September 2026, 1 - 30 November 2026, 1 - 20 December 2026, 21 December 2026 - 20 February 2027.

expect.title: Breakfast
expect.body: Most halal restaurants in Perth usually open at 10:00 AM and above. You can cook & prepare a light breakfast in the apartment, which is equipped with a basic kitchenette.

expect.title: Free & Easy Day
expect.body: During Free & Easy Day 3, no transport or guide is provided but you can explore Perth City on your own. Recommended to visit Langley Park, just 5 minutes away by walking.
